pages.text: There are five coins: Copper, Gold, Diamond, Netherite and Illyrium. Each is worth twice the one before.$(br2)A coin starts as a $(item)Shatter Blank$(), is built up into a tier's coin blank, and is then pressed in the $(l:coins/factory)Shatter Coin Factory$().
Each tier's blank is crafted around the blank of the tier below it.
